summary: One development-only entrypoint composes existing Core CLI, authenticated Server requests and local Observer. Scripted replay and reviewed fresh agents now verify the complete local workflow without implying stable deployment or R2/R3 completion.
deliveryBoundary: No new context engine, client framework, mandatory MCP, daemon or globally installed candidate skill.
Operator-reviewed absolute bindings, independently pinned Server identity, private curl credentials and task state stay outside consumer source.
Server-managed publication and explicit local Core publication are distinct. An outage cannot restore state that was only saved remotely.
No stable1.27.2 change, consumer cutover, remote deployment or release qualification is implied.
